feature_contract.goal: Retain all active D3D11 OM color MRTs and depth target across full-sized left/right native OpenXR eye copies without corrupting subsequent menu/HUD rendering, and compile portable DXGI descriptor clients without weakening live D3D11/WARP behavior. The actual R30 gameplay scene callback remains pending.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Immediate-context native stereo copies preserve and restore all eight OM RTV slots and DSV to the next game/HUD pass.
Reject deferred or invalid native source without modifying live fallback render state, and parse the restricted descriptor-only DXGI header without weakening COM checks.
Same repaired material C++ SHA passes unchanged DX11 Fast, Backend, Windows Build, OpenXR, and HUD workflows; no assertion of Quest3 playback.

integration_path: Direct live native stereo eye copy saves all active OM RTVs and DSV before unbinding and two GPU copies.
Scoped restore rebinds all 8 MRT slots and DSV after L/R array transfers; invalid/deferred contexts reject without touching fallback state.
Native WARP eye-pair regression covers two-MRT preservation, source fallback and deferred context; host SRGB descriptor-only CI enforces portable parsing.
R30 full-game menu/vehicle/race native source callback and matching Quest3 visual parity remain separate unfinished integration work.

acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Deferred-context and fallback source rejection retain OM attachments; portable restricted D3D11 header compiles; original input/FFB/DX9Ex and DXVK unaffected.

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native eye copy requires explicit opt-in, validated live frame and immediate current-device ownership; rejects source switch without destroying original D3D9/DX9Ex renderer, input or FFB.
remaining_implementation: Connect actual R30 game menu/vehicle/race scene callbacks and constants/textures to native independent L/R OpenXR eyes.
Validate matching real game and Quest3/VDXR 3D HUD, controls and frame pacing; runtime remains UNTESTED.
